notes.title: Vaultbreakers: Weekly content update [September 12th 2025]
notes.content:

[b]P.S. Trios will be introduced in this playtest! 🔥[/b][/p][p]

Meet the updated version of Sam, a swashbuckling pirate with his trusty parrot. This is the new Garrik, a mysterious old hunter who has a bit of a twist when you hear him talk to you. 🐺 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/cf298b7fd918624bc0b4477b112e6e52b55cb4d5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Vaultbreakers: April Playtest Next Week!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Join in on the fun with some new updates to the game! We finally reworked the storage system! You’ll be able to filter items, sort them, and split item stacks! New artifacts have also been added, gave voices to our NPCs, and so on!

All servers will be open for the playtest, and you can find the start and end dates below:

[b]START: April 9, 9 AM CEST
END: April 13th, 11:59 PM CEST[/b]

[i]⚠ Important note: we made some big server changes for this Playtest, and found an issue during our latest technical test. We aim to fix it before this playtest starts, but there is still a chance it may get slightly postponed. We’ll keep you posted if this happens. You can head to our Discord Server to follow the issue more closely.
[/i]
[h2]WHAT’S NEW?[/h2]

Watch the video below to get a glimpse of what you’ll experience!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KboLyUP87fo]PLAYTEST TEASER[/url]


[h2]ACTIVATABLE ITEMS[/h2]
We want you to have more ways to customize your playstyle! Activatable items will allow you to create your own kit and surprise your opponents. From a blink-stone allowing you to teleport to a short distance, to a fireball, or even a way to become temporarily invisible! You can loot activatable items on monsters.

[h2]IMPROVED WOLFSWOOD MAP[/h2]
Visit the Mage Tower, an abandoned tower around the middle of the map where you might find some good loot. We also added Explosive barrels, a new toy to annoy the Scrats with, along with some destructible environments! Some locked areas are also harder now.


If you don’t already have a playtest key from a previous playtest, then grab your playtest key here: [url=https://gleam.io/hAikf/vaultbreakers-playtest-key-giveaway]PLAYTEST KEYS[/url]

You can join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/vaultbreakers]Discord Server[/url] to follow live discussions during the event!

notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Gather your friends and join in on the fun with BIG changes to the game! The time has come for you and your friends to play the game with these brand updates.

We are back with another Project F4E Playtest! As previously, this test will run on all our servers (Europe, North America, South America, and South Asia).

[h1]Europe: Dec 4 - Dec 8, 2 PM to 12 AM CET
North America: Dec 4 - Dec 8, 4 PM to 12 AM PST
South America: Dec 4 - Dec 8, 4 PM to 12 AM BRT

[h3]GROUP PORTALS[/h3]

notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Get ready for our next Spooktacular Playtest! We'll also have a cool Halloween-themed contest, so keep your eyes on our next announcement for more details.

We are back with another Project F4E Playtest! As previously, this test will run on all our servers (Europe, North America, South America, and South Asia).

[h1]EU: Oct 30 - Nov 3, 2 PM to 12 AM CET
NA: Oct 30 - Nov 3, 4 PM to 12 AM PDT

notes.title: NEW PLAYTEST: July 11 - Join us!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's summer already, and we are back with another Project F4E Playtest! This test will run on all our servers (Europe, North America, South America, and South Asia). This one is a bit shorter because we are COOKING epic things for our next test! 

[h1]EU: July 11 - 12, 2 PM to 10 PM CEST
NA/SA: July 11 - 12, 4PM to 10 PM PDT
SEA: July 11 - 12, 4 PM to 10 PM SGT [/h1]

[url=https://gleam.io/Uzxhg/project-f4e-july-playtest]GRAB YOUR KEY HERE[/url]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]WHAT’S NEW?[/h2]

We worked on a new permanent system that will allow you to accumulate points (what we call “Legacy Points”), which will be kept forever (not wiped between playtests), allowing you to purchase some very cool rewards. It will be active even post-launch, showing off your Legacy forever. 

Prologue Points from the old iteration of F4E have now been converted to Legacy.

During this playtest, the Dragonvault will be going under maintenance for reasons such as art upgrades, bug fixes, NPC balancing and overall quality upgrades.

Make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/projectf4e]Discord server[/url] so you can chat with us and find a teammate to play with!

notes.title: NEW PLAYTEST: May 30 - Join us!
notes.content:
You are invited to playtest Project F4E in Europe, North America, and South America starting on Thursday and for 4 DAYS! 

To our Asian region players, we heard you! We have now added the South East Asia server for this playtest!!

We have some cool content and gameplay changes in this Playtest; more details are below!

[h1]EU: May 30th to June 2nd, 4PM to 10PM CEST
NA/SA : May 30thth to June 2nd, 4PM to 10PM PDT
SEA: May 30th to June 2nd, 4PM to 10PM SGT[/h1]
[i]We’ll open the servers at 2pm CEST for EU instead of 4pm on May 30th to make sure there aren’t any critical issues![/i]

[url=https://gleam.io/RjwOE/project-f4e-month-of-fun-giveaway]GRAB YOUR KEY HERE[/url]
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h2]WHAT’S NEW?[/h2]

New gameplay changes were made to help players get a chance to complete their challenges and progress through the game without having to worry about the encroaching circle. Changes were also made to help the balance between solo and duo players in the same match. Here is what you’ll experience in the upcoming test:

[h3]EMOTES[/h3]
Yes, you read that right! You can express your feelings and intents to your friends, potential new friends, and foes.

[h3]A TRAVELING MERCHANT[/h3]
Niblers is our newest NPC addition, but this time, he is not an enemy and could very well be your best friend in a time of need. Niblers will wander on the map, carrying loot in his bag that you can purchase from him, or sell things you do not need to free up space.

[h3]THE CIRCLE[/h3]
We have changed how the circle will work in Project F4E. Each match will start with 15 min on the timer, and once the timer reaches 5 min, you will get a message prompt saying “The area is becoming unstable” and the circle will start to move, so keep an eye on your map!

[h3]PORTALS[/h3]
Portals will start spawning as the circle starts to appear. Some portal locations are fixed on the map, while others will spawn next to the final circle location. 

[h3]LONE WOLF PERK[/h3]
To help with balancing solo and duo players in the same matches, we have added the Lone Wolf perk which will be given to players going in solo. This perk gives solo players some extra strength to help them against duo players.

notes.title: April 10th Playtest Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]10-13 April Playtest [/h1]
[h2]PATCH NOTES: [/h2]
The main focus has been on improving the overall combat feel, implementing new dynamic elements and mechanics on the map, and to start implementing systems that give you goals and things to do in the game (other than just trying to survive!). We also further optimized the controller support and encourage anyone who can to play using controller. 
We have also added some long-awaited quality-of-life things and minor balance tweaks. 

[h3]🗺 Map changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]We have added the next of many *Happenings* on the map. These are events or enemies that players can interact with, but who each have an agenda of their own. 
[*] Look for Pitpaw in the southwest of the map, but beware!
[*] Dragon Vault portals are now not usable unless you have a Dragon Vault Crystal with you. You get these by completing a crafting quest chain. Check the new in-game challenges to learn more about it!
[*] There is only one queue to join now. Both solo players and duo players go into the same map.
[*] Added area names to the map.
[*]Updated the encroaching circle to start later in the game, giving you more time to experience the *Happenings* and new content. To compromise, it will move slightly faster at the end of the game.
[/list]

[h3]👹Enemy changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Many new named enemies traverse the map. These have stronger variations of existing abilities and have better loot. Some of them are part of quest chains and/or dynamic elements on the map.
[*] Enemies move around on the map.
[*]   - Some will just patrol the immediate vicinity of where they spawn. Others will go on longer patrols either alone or in groups.
[*] Enemies now have randomized initial ability cooldowns.
[*] Clearer indicators on some of the bosses’ abilities.
[*] Clearer ground indicators for the Spiderlings.
[*] New regular enemy abilities.
[/list]

[h3]🧝‍♀️Character changes[/h3]
- Hearthguard
    - [b]Major rework:[/b] We want to move in a direction where the accumulation of stacks and buffs on the characters is more rewarding and has a bigger payoff.
    - Check the Hearthguard’s abilities in-game for all the changes.
- Lightningcaller
    - Improved Lightningcaller’s basic attack casting VFX
    - Improved values, colors, and cast time of power vortex cast VFX.
    - Added a cast VFX to Zap Bang.
    - Changed the Ultra to be depending on the Energy you have when triggering it, and giving it a shorter cooldown.

[h3]💠 Misc[/h3]
- [b]We opened a South American server for this test due to a massive influx of testers from there.[/b]
- You can drop items on the ground by pressing X on your keyboard
- There are now 2 consumable slots available. You can use consumables by pressing the 1 and 2 keys on your keyboard
- New and improved icons for all items!
- Renamed the old “Shoulders” slot to “Trinkets” together with the new icons.
- Continuous performance optimization.
- Improved the UI for recipe books.
- You can now use the scroll button to zoom in or out from your character.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
- Fixed that indicators for skill shots didn’t always match projectile size.
- Fixed Imp Bolter projectile height
- Optimized all enemy colliders to indicate projectile impact more clearly.
- Fixed a bug where footstep audio would not work correctly inside the fog.
- Fixing Barrel Scrat’s attack animation timing.
- Fixed a missing outline for characters in smoke.
- Fixed the broken Named Item and enabled them in the dropables again.
- Fixed the wrong timing for the Elite Scrat Netters.

[h3]🤔Known issues[/h3]
- Rock Muncher lacks audio
- The client will sometimes crash when you try to close it.
- Some enemies can get stuck when they leash and try to return to their starting point.
- One of the first challenges still calls for you to try and defeat a Swarmer even though most of the Swarmers have been replaced with Rock Munchers. There are events in the map that summon Swarmers though, so you are still able to complete the challenge.
- The Hearthguard can sometimes be slowed for a longer time by the oil. This usually resolves itself after a basic attack.
- Some small invisible colliders are on the map along the edges of passageways.
- The second consumable slot doesn’t have auto-equip from loot containers.
- Keybinding to right-click causes problems with interacting with items.

notes.title: Building a dynamic world in Project F4E
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

We’ve started working (and implementing) one of the big aspects of what Project F4E will be: the dynamic world initiative™

Just like the Scrat train (for those of you who have already played the game), we want to add many other dynamic elements to the map. Our goal is to create more unexpected situations, leading to more excitement, more indicators about where other players are, and an additional strategic layer to plan your mission accordingly and adapt to events. 
Here is what you’ll experience in the upcoming test:

[h2]Patrols![/h2]

Now, several monsters will scout the area instead of staying static and idling.

[h2]Named Enemies![/h2]

You’ll now be able to find some unique and named enemies across the map. They have their own goal and might impact the state of the map! One of them is [b]PitPaw[/b], the mad alchemist. PitPaw wants to run an experiment on a rare bread of Shardspine Muncher and must go to his lab to conduct it. What will happen if he succeeds? I wonder. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/4b4c6f5b42cf35b91c552931b147cc53fd389cb3.png[/img]

[h2]New Progression system[/h2]

We want players to gradually unlock new content and elements. That’s why we are experimenting a new quest chain system to gain access to the DragonVault. The Vault is a dangerous place and you’ll have to prove your might before being able to break into it! 

What do you think of this update? If you have any suggestions or things you would like to see toward this initiative, share them in the comments!

notes.title: New Direction for Project F4E + Playtest next week
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

If you follow us on Discord, you’re probably already aware of this, but we are changing Project F4E’s gameplay. 

[b]We’re organizing a Playtest next week.[/b] Make sure to check this news until the end to see the details and how to participate.

Our initial objective was to create a game that allowed players to form meaningful friendships through special friend features in an MMO MOBA-like game. But, while we added new content, we weren't satisfied with the results. We knew we had to do better and create something extraordinary.

That's when we stumbled upon the "[b]Loot & Extract[/b]" genre, which has become our new obsession. We were thrilled to discover that it offers a thrilling, high-stakes experience that can lead to unforgettable memories and deepened friendships!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/f002871b5baac2fc875b0a9e4f45632885ba09c2.jpg[/img]

In Project F4E, you can team up with your friends or strangers and use magical Portals to explore dangerous fantasy environments and gather epic loot to become stronger. [i]However[/i], you're not alone. There are other teams that all have their own goals!

You can choose to avoid them and focus on getting loot from monsters or hunt them to get their gear.
[b]But beware[/b]… If you die, you will lose all the gear you haven’t placed in your stash! The unpredictability of each session offers great replayability and makes it easy for friends to have continuous play sessions together. You can also team up with strangers in the game and ignite brand-new friendships.

Through Project F4E, we aim to create new friendships by engaging in tense and hardcore sessions with high stakes where you must work together to survive and extract.

[b]We know this might be sad news for some of you[/b], but we're confident that this new direction will surpass your expectations. It provides a great balance between progression and avoiding massive power gaps between sessions. We already did several Playtests with players, and we’re very happy with the results and our progress. We can't wait for you to join us on this new journey.

[h2]Playtest the new version next week!
[/h2]
[b][u]Date:[/u] March 31st, 4:00 PM CET to 9:00 PM (the test will last 5 hours)
[/b]
[b]How to participate?
[/b]
1. Fill out this form: [url=https://forms.gle/idKoJkpwqDBiNrZP6]https://forms.gle/idKoJkpwqDBiNrZP6[/url]
2. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/projectf4e]Discord Server[/url] and get the Playtest Role (either by going to the #role channel or using the Channels & Role Discord feature)
3. Read our latest Playtest announcement in #playtest-announcement and react to it.

If you want to check what has changed since the last time your played Project F4E, you can check the game-tutorial channel on Discord! Feel free to ask your questions on the server too.
If you don't want to use Discord, we'll start organizing bigger playtests available to everyone who has a key at some point, but we don't have an exact date yet.

[*] This is a series of challenging narrative missions where you face invaders in a multi-front war extravaganza.

[/h2]

[/b]Here are the missions:

1. Log in during the Season: 10PP
2. Win the 1st World Map Mission: 20PP
3. Defeat a Succubus Screecher: 25PP
4. Defeat a Netherlord Broodmother: 30PP
5. Win the 3rd World Map Mission: 30PP
6. Get a class to Rank 7: 30PP

Please fill out the feedback form that you'll find in the game. That would help us a lot <3

Have fun!!

notes.title: Next Season starts in 7 days!
notes.content:
Greetings Knights, 

One week left before the new Season! Are you ready?? 

For the occasion, we’re going to talk about our biggest change for this season: [b]the Equipment System 🏹[/b]! (I’m sure the name of the Season didn’t give you any clue regarding this feature 🧐)

Just like an MMORPG, you’ll be able to equip your classes with a variety of equipment, giving you special stats. [i]Time to pimp your Frost Barbarian[/i]🙌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41928451/9587cd16c20af288de130078f41023e690e838ec.png[/img]


[list]
[*] You earn equipment after each mission you play and they are linked to the class you were playing during these missions
[*] Equipment can have 4 different rarities
[*] You have 4 equipment slots at first, and you can unlock more slots by leveling up your classes
[/list]

The feature is still a prototype, so don’t hesitate to send us all your feedback in the Community Hub, they are very valuable to us ❤

Don't forget to sign up for our newsletter for exclusive content! Here: [url=https://bit.ly/F4ENews]https://bit.ly/F4ENews[/url]
Happy Easter 🐰

notes.title: Discover Project F4E Prologue first Pre-launch Season
notes.content:
Hey Rifters,

We have really ✨Exciting✨ news for you today - we’re thrilled to announce the[url=https://betadwarf.com/f4e/] Project F4E Prologue[/url]! 

What is the Prologue you ask? Well thanks for asking, it is:

- A massive and wonderful pre-launch campaign that includes a lot of 🚀[b]Pre-Launch Seasons[/b].
- In each 🚀[b]Pre-Launch Season[/b] you can earn ⭐[b]Prologue Points[/b] by completing the specific 📜[b]Prologue Quests[/b] that each season will have.
- If you earn enough ⭐[b]Prologue Points[/b] you’ll be rewarded with 🎁[b]Exclusive Gifts[/b] that cannot be earned after launch (yep!).
- Check out the Prologue and the upcoming 🚀[b]Pre-Launch Season[/b] at the Prologue website

Behold the first [b]🚀Pre-Launch Season -🛡️Knights of Power![/b]

It will start on March [u][b]18th 4:00pm CET[/b][/u] and will last until [u][b]March 20th 11:59pm CET[/b][/u].

Among many things you can look forward to some cross mission progression, in-game chat, .e. ..e.i.. and more!

We are really excited for you to start participating in the Prologue!

🔑How to get access:

- If you have a F4E Discord key, send a private message to @[BD] Sofilia (any message will do) and she will give you a Steam key, BUT it only works when the season is live.
- If you have a Steam Key you can simply play when the Season starts.
- If you have neither, let us know on the community hub if you think we should make a giveaway and we’ll consider it!

You can share all your thoughts (and even send encouragement messages to the team ;) ) on the community hub
